In the Nxeon codebase at /opt/nxeon, read prisma/schema.prisma and produce a precise field inventory for the models I'll build a customer-support AI agent's read-only lookup tools around. This is a VPS/hosting platform (like Hostinger).

For EACH of these models, list the exact field names + types + any enums, and note the relation/foreign-key field that ties a row to a User (e.g. userId, ownerId, organizationId, or via Membership). I need exact names to write Prisma queries — do not paraphrase field names.

Models to map:
1. User (esp. id, email, name, and any org/membership relation)
2. Server (VPS instances — power state, specs, plan, node, hostname, ip, status fields, createdAt, and the field linking to the owner)
3. HostingAccount (shared hosting — username, domain, plan, status, node, quota/usage fields, owner link)
4. Invoice (status, amount/total, dueDate, paidAt, currency, number, owner link, line items relation)
5. WalletTransaction and/or Transaction (amount, type, status, createdAt, owner link) — whichever exist
6. Domain (name, status, registrar, expiry/renewal dates, autoRenew, owner link)
7. GameServer if it exists, else GamePlan/GameSchedule (game type, status, slots, node, owner link)
8. Ticket + TicketMessage (subject, status, priority, body/message fields, owner link, timestamps) — this is the support-ticket model; I need enough to CREATE a ticket on the customer's behalf
9. Migration (source, target, status/phase, owner link, timestamps)
10. SslCertificate (domain, status, issuer, expiry, owner link)
11. EmailSubscription and/or Mailbox/CompanyMailbox (plan, status, owner link) — the business-email product
12. Subscription models generally (EmailSubscription, and any Server/Hosting subscription/billing-cycle fields showing renewal date + price + status)
13. Coupon + CouponRedemption (code, discount, scope, and how redemption ties to a user) — just enough to explain active deals
14. Announcement / StatusIncident (for "is there an outage?" — fields for active/severity/title/body/time)

Also:
- Find how the app resolves "the current user's servers/services" today — look at lib/kb-tools.ts (existing tools get_account_overview, list_services, get_service, list_invoices, get_billing_status, list_tickets) and report the EXACT Prisma query patterns they use (which models, which where-clauses, which relations) so my new tools stay consistent.
- Report any enum definitions referenced (server status, invoice status, ticket status/priority, domain status, migration status).

Output a compact but PRECISE reference: model name → fields (name: type) → owner-link field → relevant enum values. Include the exact existing kb-tools query patterns verbatim where short. Do not write new code; just report facts I can build against.

# Nxeon schema field inventory — support-agent read-only lookups

**Ownership model (critical):** Every customer service links to the owner by a **direct `userId String` scalar** (+ `user User @relation`). There is **no org/tenant indirection** for services — `Organization`/`Membership` exist only as a separate teams feature and are NOT how servers/invoices/etc. are owned. All existing kb-tools scope `where: { userId }` directly. Follow that pattern. Money is **integer cents** everywhere (`*Cents`).

File: `/opt/nxeon/prisma/schema.prisma` · Existing tools: `/opt/nxeon/lib/kb-tools.ts`

## 1. User (schema L93–206)
`id: String @id` · `email: String @unique` · `name: String` · `role: Role @default(CUSTOMER)` · `balanceCents: Int` · `signupCreditCents: Int` · `suspended: Boolean` · `createdAt: DateTime` · `emailVerifiedAt: DateTime?`
Card mirror (display only, never charge with these): `cardBrand/cardLast4: String?`, `cardExpMonth/cardExpYear: Int?` · `stripeCustomerId/stripePaymentMethodId: String?`
Growth: `referralCode: String? @unique`, `referredById: String?`
Org relations: `ownedOrgs Organization[] @relation("OrgOwner")`, `memberships Membership[]` — **not** used for service ownership.
Back-relations: `servers`, `hostingAccounts`, `domains`, `invoices`, `emailSubscriptions`, `volumes`, `tickets`, `transactions` (→WalletTransaction), `nxcloudInstances`, `couponRedemptions`.
**Enum Role** = `CUSTOMER | SUPPORT | BILLING | ADMIN`.
`Organization` (L1897): `id`, `name`, `ownerId String`, `owner User @relation("OrgOwner")`. `Membership` (L1906): `id`, `orgId`, `userId String`, `role String @default("MEMBER")` (freeform: OWNER|ADMIN|MEMBER|BILLING), `@@unique([orgId, userId])`.

## 2. Server (VPS / game / NxCloud VM) (L387–573)
`id: String @id` · `name: String` · `label: String?` (customer nickname) · `hostname: String` · `vmid: Int? @unique` · `status: ServerStatus @default(PENDING)` · `ipAddress: String? @unique` · `ipv6: String?` · `sshPort: Int?` · `isFree: Boolean` · `autoRenew: Boolean` · `expiresAt: DateTime?` (= renewal date) · `termMonths: Int` · `createdAt/updatedAt`
Owner link: **`userId: String`** · `user User @relation` (no cascade). Node link: `nodeId: String?` · `node Node?`.
Type discriminators: `gamePlanId: String?` (→ game server), `nxcloudInstance NxCloudInstance?` (→ managed Nextcloud), else VPS. `gameVariant: String?`, `gameConfig: Json?`.
Specs live on relation `plan Plan` (`planId: String`) — Plan has `name, cpuCores, ramMB, diskGB`; plus `extraDiskGB: Int` on Server. `gamePlan GamePlan?` for game rows.
Suspension/dunning/errors: `suspendReason: String?`, `suspendedNote: String?`, `provisionError: String?`, `dunningStage: Int`, `dunningNextAt: DateTime?`, `dunningPayUrl: String?`.
`backupTier: BackupTier @default(FREE)`, `wantsDedicatedIp: Boolean`, `projectId: String?`.
**Enum ServerStatus** = `PENDING | PROVISIONING | RUNNING | STOPPED | SUSPENDED | REINSTALLING | DELETING | ERROR`. (No live power-toggle field; `status` is the power state. Jobs carry actions — enum JobType incl. `START|STOP|REBOOT|GAME_POWER…`, JobStatus = `QUEUED|RUNNING|DONE|FAILED`.)
**Enum BackupTier** = `FREE | PLUS | PRO | PREMIUM`.
`Node` (L800): `id`, `name @unique`, `pveNode`, `publicIp`, `status: NodeStatus`. **Enum NodeStatus** = `ONLINE | OFFLINE | MAINTENANCE`.

## 3. HostingAccount (shared hosting) (L1125–1226)
`id` · **`userId: String`** · `user User @relation` (Cascade) · `hostingNodeId: String` → `node HostingNode` · `planId: String` → `plan HostingPlan` · `username: String` (jailed system user) · `primaryDomain: String` · `status: HostingAccountStatus @default(PENDING)` · `phpVersion: String @default("8.3")`

Billing/errors: `termMonths: Int` · `expiresAt: DateTime?` (renewal) · `error: String?` · `provisionedAt: DateTime?` · `suspendedNote: String?` · `createdAt/updatedAt`. `@@index([userId])`.
**Enum HostingAccountStatus** = `PENDING | PROVISIONING | ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | FAILED | DELETING`.
`HostingPlan` (L1090): `slug @unique`, `name`, `priceCents`, `diskGB`, `maxSites`, `maxDatabases`, `mailboxes`. **Enum HostingNodeStatus** = `ONLINE | DEGRADED | OFFLINE`.

## 4. Invoice (L833–868)
`id` · `number: Int @unique @default(autoincrement())` · **`userId: String`** · `user User @relation` (Cascade) · `amountCents: Int` (total incl tax) · `taxCents: Int` · `taxRatePercent: Float` · `taxCountry: String?` · `status: InvoiceStatus @default(OPEN)` · `refundedCents: Int` · `description: String` · `lineItems: Json` (embedded array `[{description, qty, unitCents, amountCents}]` — **NOT a relation**) · `periodStart/periodEnd: DateTime?` · `paidAt: DateTime?` · `paidBrand/paidLast4: String?` · `createdAt`. **Enum InvoiceStatus** = `OPEN | PAID | VOID | REFUNDED` (OPEN = unpaid).

## 5. WalletTransaction (L675–687) — the only ledger model (no `Transaction`)
`id` · **`userId: String`** · `user User @relation` · `amountCents: Int` (signed: credit positive / debit negative) · `description: String` · `createdAt: DateTime` · `stripeSessionId/stripePaymentIntentId: String? @unique`. **No `type` or `status` field** — type is inferred from sign/description.

## 6. Domain (L281–315)
`id` · `name: String @unique` · `status: DomainStatus @default(PENDING)` · `registrar: String @default("namecheap")` · `autoRenew: Boolean` · `nameservers: String[]` · `whoisPrivacy: Boolean` · `registeredAt: DateTime?` · `expiresAt: DateTime?` (renewal/expiry) · `error: String?` · **`userId: String`** · `user User @relation` (Cascade) · `createdAt` · `priceCents/costCents: Int` · `termYears: Int`
Transfer-in: `isTransferIn: Boolean`, `transferStatus: String?` (raw registrar string), `transferStartedAt/transferEmail`.
**Enum DomainStatus** = `PENDING | ACTIVE | FAILED | EXPIRED | TRANSFER_PENDING | TRANSFER_FAILED`.

## 7. Game servers — no `GameServer` model
Game servers ARE `Server` rows with `gamePlanId` set. **`GamePlan`** (L1788): `id`, `gameFamily: String` (minecraft/valheim/rust/…), `name`, `ramMB`, `cpuCores`, `diskGB`, `slots: Int?`, `priceCents`, `termMonths`, `basePlanId`, `active`, `featured`. **`GameSchedule`** (L585): `id`, `serverId` → `server Server` (Cascade), `kind String @default("restart")`, `hour/minute: Int` (UTC), `enabled`, `announce`, `nextRunAt: DateTime?`. Owner is via `Server.userId`.

## 8. Ticket + TicketMessage (L245–266) — for CREATING a ticket on the customer's behalf
`Ticket`: `id` · `subject: String` · `status: TicketStatus @default(OPEN)` · `priority: TicketPriority @default(NORMAL)` · **`userId: String`** · `user User @relation` (Cascade) · `messages TicketMessage[]` · `createdAt` · `updatedAt`.
`TicketMessage`: `id` · **`body: String`** (the message text) · `isStaff: Boolean @default(false)` · `ticketId: String` · `ticket Ticket @relation` (Cascade) · `authorId: String` · `author User @relation` (Cascade) · `createdAt`.
To create on a customer's behalf: `Ticket` needs `subject`, `userId` (defaults cover status/priority); nested/first `TicketMessage` needs `body`, `ticketId`, `authorId` (the customer's userId), `isStaff: false`.

## Existing kb-tools.ts query patterns (verbatim, to stay consistent)

All tools take a **trusted `userId` function arg**; input never carries ownership. Ownership is re-checked with `findFirst({ where: { id, userId } })`.

**Open-ticket constant:** `const OPEN_TICKET_STATUSES: TicketStatus[] = ["OPEN", "ANSWERED", "CUSTOMER_REPLY"];`

**Service-type classifier:** `nxcloudInstance` present → `"nxcloud"`; else `gamePlanId` present → `"game"`; else `"vps"`.

**get_account_overview** counts, each scoped to `userId`:
- `db.server.findMany({ where: { userId, status: { not: "DELETING" } }, select: { status, gamePlanId, nxcloudInstance: { select: { id } } } })`
- `db.hostingAccount.groupBy({ by: ["status"], where: { userId, status: { not: "DELETING" } }, _count: true })`
- `db.emailSubscription.count({ where: { userId } })` · `db.domain.count({ where: { userId } })` · `db.volume.count({ where: { userId, status: { not: "DELETING" } } })`
- `db.invoice.findMany({ where: { userId, status: "OPEN" }, select: { amountCents } })`
- `db.ticket.count({ where: { userId, status: { in: OPEN_TICKET_STATUSES } } })`
- Dunning: `db.server.count({ where: { userId, isFree: false, expiresAt: { lt: now }, status: { in: ["RUNNING","STOPPED","SUSPENDED"] } } })`

**list_services** — parallel `findMany` on `server`, `hostingAccount`, `emailSubscription`, `domain`, `volume`, each `where: { userId, status: { not: "DELETING" } }` (domain/email have no DELETING filter), `orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" }, take: 20`, plan name via `plan: { select: { name } }`.

**get_service** — ownership check pattern repeated per model: `db.server.findFirst({ where: { id, userId }, … })`, then `hostingAccount`, `emailSubscription`, `domain`, `volume`, `nxCloudInstance` — first match wins, else returns `"not found or not yours"`.

**list_invoices** — `db.invoice.findMany({ where: { userId }, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, take: limit, select: { number, amountCents, refundedCents, status, description, createdAt, paidAt } })`. limit clamped 1–10.

**get_billing_status** — user card/balance select; `db.invoice.findMany({ where: { userId, status: "OPEN" }, … })`; overdue `db.server.findMany({ where: { userId, isFree: false, expiresAt: { lt: now }, status: { in: ["RUNNING","STOPPED","SUSPENDED"] } }, select: { …, dunningStage, dunningNextAt, suspendReason } })`; next renewal `db.server.findFirst({ where: { userId, isFree: false, autoRenew: true, expiresAt: { gte: now }, status: { in: ["RUNNING","STOPPED"] } }, orderBy: { expiresAt: "asc" }, select: { expiresAt } })`.

**list_tickets** — `db.ticket.findMany({ where: { userId, status: { in: OPEN_TICKET_STATUSES } }, orderBy: { updatedAt: "desc" }, take: 20, select: { id, subject, status, priority, updatedAt, _count: { select: { messages: true } } } })`.

**Consistency notes for new tools:** always scope `where: { userId }` (services are never org-owned); re-check foreign ids with `findFirst({ where: { id, userId } })`; money is integer cents rendered via `formatMoney`; never select secret fields (`rootPassword*`, `*Enc`, `verifyToken`, tokens); `Migration`/`SslCertificate`/`EmailSubscription`/`Mailbox`/`Volume` statuses are plain Strings (no enum type import), whereas `Server`/`Invoice`/`Ticket`/`Domain`/`HostingAccount` statuses are real Prisma enums.
